title: Atestar por red el hardening de capability tokens de Tele
mission: Independently fetch the public GitHub Pages TV room client and remote shell after the capability-secret hardening, verify the served bytes expose the session-scoped TV room store and post-parse URL-fragment scrub, and record exact served hashes/status. Static network attestation only: do not claim interactive browser behavior, Human Accepted or Served promotion.
definition_of_done: Fetch https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/experiments/prometeo-live/remote-room-v1.js and https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/experiments/prometeo-remote/ with cache-busting using an unrestricted public HTTP origin fetch.
Record HTTP status plus a content hash for each served response or an exact network/CDN boundary.
Served TV client contains sessionStorage set/get/remove for STORE and no localStorage access for STORE.
Served remote parses room/token from the fragment and scrubs the fragment with history.replaceState after parsing.
Do not substitute repository branch bytes for served-network evidence and do not infer interactive-browser or Human Accepted/Served status.
